q: In which town was the wedding where Jesus did His first sign?
why: Jesus' mother was there too.
quote: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee.

q: At the wedding in Cana, what ran out?
why: Jesus' mother told Him about it.
quote: When the wine ran out

q: At the wedding in Cana, what did Jesus' mother tell the servants?
why: She trusted Jesus to help.
quote: Do whatever He tells you.

q: At the wedding in Cana, what did Jesus tell the servants to fill the jars with?
why: They filled them to the brim.
quote: Fill the jars with water.

q: At the wedding in Cana, what did the water in the jars become?
why: It was Jesus' first sign.
quote: the water that had been turned into wine.

q: At Cana, what did the master of the banquet say about the wine Jesus made?
a: The best was saved until now
why: Jesus' wine was the finest.
quote: But you have saved the fine wine until now!

q: Which of Jesus' signs was turning water into wine at Cana?
why: His disciples believed in Him.
quote: Jesus performed this, the first of His signs, at Cana in Galilee.

q: Who was Nicodemus, the man who came to talk with Jesus?
why: He wanted to learn from Jesus.
quote: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a leader of the Jews.

q: At what time of day did Nicodemus come to see Jesus?
why: He came quietly.
quote: He came to Jesus at night

q: Jesus told Nicodemus no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is what?
why: Everyone needs a new start from God.
quote: no one can see the kingdom of God unless he is born again.

q: When Jesus said he must be born again, what did Nicodemus ask?
a: How can an old man be born?
why: He did not understand yet.
quote: How can a man be born when he is old?

q: In His talk with Nicodemus, why did Jesus say God gave His one and only Son?
why: It is the most famous verse in the Bible.
quote: For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son

q: Jesus told Nicodemus that everyone who believes in God's Son will have what?
why: They will not perish.
quote: that everyone who believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.

q: Jesus told Nicodemus God sent His Son into the world not to condemn it, but to do what?
why: God's purpose was rescue.
quote: but to save the world through Him.

q: Tired from His journey through Samaria, where did Jesus sit down?
why: It was about noon.
quote: Since Jacob’s well was there, Jesus, weary from His journey, sat down by the well.

q: At Jacob's well, what did Jesus ask the Samaritan woman?
wrong: Is this the way to town?
why: She had come to draw water.
quote: Give Me a drink.

q: Why was the Samaritan woman surprised that Jesus asked her for a drink?
why: Jesus broke the barrier.
quote: (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)

q: At the well, what did Jesus say He could give the Samaritan woman?
why: He meant the gift of eternal life.
quote: and He would have given you living water.

q: Jesus told the woman at the well that whoever drinks the water He gives will never what?
why: His water springs up to eternal life.
quote: But whoever drinks the water I give him will never thirst.

q: When the woman at the well spoke of the coming Messiah, what did Jesus answer?
a: I who speak to you am He
why: Jesus told her plainly who He was.
quote: I who speak to you am He.

q: After talking with Jesus, what did the Samaritan woman leave behind at the well?
why: She hurried to tell her town.
quote: Then the woman left her water jar

q: Why did many Samaritans from the town believe in Jesus?
why: She told everyone what He said.
quote: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in Jesus because of the woman’s testimony

q: When a huge crowd came to Jesus, which disciple did He ask where to buy bread?
why: Jesus was testing him.
quote: He said to Philip, “Where can we buy bread for these people to eat?”

q: When Jesus fed the five thousand, who had the five loaves and two small fish?
why: Jesus used a small gift to feed many.
quote: Here is a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish.

q: What kind of loaves did the boy have when Jesus fed the five thousand?
why: Barley bread was simple food.
quote: five barley loaves

q: Which disciple told Jesus about the boy with the loaves and fish?
why: He was Simon Peter's brother.
quote: One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to Him

q: Before handing out the loaves and fish to the crowd, what did Jesus do?
why: Everyone got as much as they wanted.
quote: Then Jesus took the loaves and the fish, gave thanks

q: After the crowd was full, why did Jesus have the leftovers gathered?
why: God's gifts are precious.
quote: Gather the pieces that are left over, so that nothing will be wasted.

q: How many baskets were filled with leftovers after Jesus fed the five thousand?
why: There was more left than at the start.
quote: and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves

q: In which village did Lazarus and his sisters Mary and Martha live?
why: Jesus loved this family.
quote: He lived in Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.

q: What message did Mary and Martha send Jesus about their brother Lazarus?
a: The one You love is sick
why: They knew Jesus could help.
quote: Lord, the one You love is sick.

q: When Jesus arrived in Bethany, how long had Lazarus been in the tomb?
why: Everyone thought it was too late.
quote: When Jesus arrived, He found that Lazarus had already spent four days in the tomb.

q: Before raising Lazarus, what did Jesus say to Martha about Himself?
a: I am the resurrection and the life
wrong: I am the bread of life
I am the light of the world
why: Whoever believes in Him will live.
quote: I am the resurrection and the life.

q: Seeing the people mourning for Lazarus, what did Jesus do?
why: Jesus cares when we are sad.
quote: Jesus wept.

q: At Lazarus's tomb, what did Jesus tell them to take away?
why: He was about to call Lazarus out.
quote: “Take away the stone,” Jesus said.

q: What did Jesus call out in a loud voice at Lazarus's tomb?
why: And the dead man came out.
quote: Lazarus, come out!

q: When Lazarus came out of the tomb, how were his hands and feet?
why: Jesus told them to unwrap him.
quote: The man who had been dead came out with his hands and feet bound in strips of linen

q: At supper with His disciples, what did Jesus wrap around His waist?
why: He took the place of a servant.
quote: and wrapped a towel around His waist.

q: At the supper before He died, what did Jesus begin to do for His disciples?
why: It was a servant's job.
quote: began to wash the disciples’ feet and dry them with the towel

q: When Jesus came to wash his feet, what did Peter first say?
a: Never shall You wash my feet!
why: Peter felt Jesus was too great to do this.
quote: “Never shall You wash my feet!” Peter told Him.

q: After Jesus explained the foot washing, what did Peter ask Him to wash too?
why: Peter wanted to belong to Jesus fully.
quote: not only my feet, but my hands and my head as well!

q: After washing their feet, what did Jesus say His disciples should do?
why: They should serve each other.
quote: you also should wash one another’s feet.

q: Why did Jesus say He washed His disciples' feet?
why: They should do as He did.
quote: I have set you an example so that you should do as I have done for you.

q: After washing His disciples' feet, what new commandment did Jesus give?
why: As He loved them, they must love each other.
quote: A new commandment I give you: Love one another.

q: In John's Gospel, who went to Jesus' tomb early while it was still dark?
why: She found the stone removed.
quote: Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.

q: When Mary Magdalene first saw the risen Jesus, who did she think He was?
why: She did not recognize Him at first.
quote: Thinking He was the gardener

q: How did Mary Magdalene recognize the risen Jesus?
why: The Good Shepherd knows His sheep by name.
quote: Jesus said to her, “Mary.”

q: How does the Gospel of John begin?
a: In the beginning was the Word
why: The Word is Jesus.
quote: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

q: John's Gospel says the Word became flesh and did what?
why: God came to live with us.
quote: The Word became flesh and made His dwelling among us.

q: When John the Baptist saw Jesus coming, what did he call Him?
why: He takes away the sin of the world.
quote: Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

q: What did Andrew tell his brother Simon after meeting Jesus?
why: Then he brought Simon to Jesus.
quote: We have found the Messiah

q: When Jesus first met Simon, what new name did He give him?
why: Both names mean rock.
quote: You will be called Cephas” (which is translated as Peter).

q: Jesus told Nicodemus the Son of Man must be lifted up, just as Moses lifted up what?
why: Looking to Jesus brings life.
quote: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up

q: Jesus told Nicodemus no one can enter God's kingdom unless born of what?
why: God gives new life.
quote: unless he is born of water and the Spirit.

q: At the well, how many husbands did Jesus say the Samaritan woman had had?
why: Jesus knew her whole story.
quote: In fact, you have had five husbands

q: Jesus told the woman at the well that God's worshipers must worship Him in what?
why: God is Spirit.
quote: His worshipers must worship Him in spirit and in truth.

q: What did the Samaritan woman tell her town about Jesus?
a: He told me everything I did
why: She wondered if He was the Christ.
quote: Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did.

q: When Jesus asked about buying bread for the crowd, what did Philip say?
a: Two hundred denarii wouldn't be enough
why: Philip saw only the problem.
quote: Two hundred denarii would not buy enough bread for each of them to have a small piece.

q: Jesus said, “I am the bread of life.” Whoever comes to Him will never do what?
why: Jesus satisfies the soul.
quote: I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to Me will never hunger

q: Jesus said, “I am the light of the world.” Whoever follows Him will never walk in what?
why: They will have the light of life.
quote: Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness

q: Jesus said He is the good shepherd. What does the good shepherd do for the sheep?
why: Jesus gave His life for us.
quote: The good shepherd lays down His life for the sheep.

q: When Jesus heard Lazarus was sick, what did He say the sickness was for?
why: The Son of God would be glorified.
quote: No, it is for the glory of God

q: After hearing Lazarus was sick, how long did Jesus stay where He was?
why: God's timing was perfect.
quote: He stayed where He was for two days

q: When Jesus said to take away the stone, what did Martha warn Him?
why: Lazarus had been dead four days.
quote: Lord, by now he stinks

q: When Peter questioned the foot washing, what did Jesus tell him?
why: Peter did not yet see its meaning.
quote: You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.

q: Jesus said everyone will know you are His disciples by what?
why: Love is the mark of a Christian.
quote: By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.

q: Complete Jesus' words: “I am the way and the truth and the…”
why: No one comes to the Father except through Him.
quote: I am the way and the truth and the life.

q: Complete Jesus' words: “I am the vine and you are the…”
why: Apart from Him we can do nothing.
quote: I am the vine and you are the branches.

q: In John's Gospel, what did Jesus say just before He gave up His spirit?
why: His work of salvation was complete.
quote: He said, “It is finished.”

q: What did Thomas say he had to see before he would believe Jesus had risen?
a: The nail marks in His hands
why: He wanted proof.
quote: Unless I see the nail marks in His hands

q: When Thomas saw the risen Jesus, what did he say?
why: His doubt turned to worship.
quote: Thomas replied, “My Lord and my God!”

q: After Thomas believed, whom did Jesus call blessed?
why: That includes believers today.
quote: blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.

q: After breakfast by the sea, what did the risen Jesus ask Peter three times?
why: Peter had denied Him three times.
quote: Simon son of John, do you love Me more than these?

q: When Peter first said he loved Jesus by the sea, what did Jesus tell him?
why: Jesus gave Peter a job to do.
quote: Jesus replied, “Feed My lambs.”

q: At the wedding in Cana, how many stone water jars were there?
why: They were for Jewish purification rites.
quote: Now six stone water jars had been set there

q: How much could each stone jar at the wedding in Cana hold?
why: Jesus made a huge amount of wine.
quote: Each could hold from twenty to thirty gallons.

q: In which Samaritan town was the well where Jesus met the woman?
why: It was near land Jacob gave to Joseph.
quote: So He came to a town of Samaria called Sychar

q: About what hour was it when Jesus sat down by Jacob's well?
why: It was about noon, the hottest time.
quote: It was about the sixth hour.

q: Who was one of the two disciples of John the Baptist who first followed Jesus?
why: He then brought his brother Simon.
quote: Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, was one of the two who heard John’s testimony and followed Jesus.

q: When Jesus first met Simon, whose son did He say Simon was?
why: Then He renamed him Cephas.
quote: You are Simon son of John.

q: Which of Lazarus's sisters would anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His feet with her hair?
why: John mentions it to identify her.
quote: (Mary, whose brother Lazarus was sick, was to anoint the Lord with perfume and wipe His feet with her hair.)

q: When Lazarus came out of the tomb, what was his face wrapped in?
why: His hands and feet were bound with linen.
quote: and his face wrapped in a cloth.

q: By what other name was the apostle Thomas called?
why: Didymus means twin.
quote: Now Thomas called Didymus, one of the Twelve

q: How many days later did the risen Jesus appear again, this time with Thomas present?
why: The doors were locked, but Jesus stood among them.
quote: Eight days later, His disciples were once again inside with the doors locked, and Thomas was with them.

q: What Hebrew word did Mary Magdalene say when she recognized the risen Jesus?
why: It means Teacher.
quote: “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).

q: The second time Peter said he loved Jesus, what did Jesus tell him?
why: Jesus restored Peter as a leader.
quote: Jesus told him, “Shepherd My sheep.”

q: Before washing the disciples' feet, what did Jesus pour water into?
why: He dried their feet with His towel.
quote: He poured water into a basin
